strings.XTLS-Vision 消除“TLS 套 TLS”的包长与时序规律，这正是大多数: XTLS-Vision removes the packet-size and timing patterns of "TLS inside TLS", the main signal most proxy protocols are detected by.

strings.一键连接，线路自愈: One tap to connect, self-healing routes
strings.下载中断，请检查网络后重试: Download interrupted. Check your network and try again.
strings.下载后点击安装包安装；如被拦截，请在系统设置里允许「安装未知应用」。: Tap the downloaded package to install. If it is blocked, allow "Install unknown apps" in system settings.
strings.下载完成后自动安装并重新打开，期间会断开 VPN。: Installs and reopens automatically when the download finishes. The VPN disconnects meanwhile.
strings.主通道之外另备一条 HTTP/2 形态的通道，流量特征完全不同，并共用 443: Besides the main channel there is a second, HTTP/2-shaped one with completely different traffic features on the same port 443. If one is blocked, it switches automatically.
strings.仅 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 等 AI 服务走专线，其余全部直: Only AI services such as ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini use the dedicated line, everything else goes direct; the most stable nodes are picked automatically.
strings.从密钥协商到数据传输，每一层都独立防护。即使链路被完整截获，看到的也只是一段无法: Every layer is protected on its own, from key exchange to data transfer. Even a fully captured link shows only ordinary HTTPS traffic that can't be read or classified.
strings.你访问 HTTPS 网站时，内层 TLS 由你的设备与目标网站直接建立，节点只负: When you visit an HTTPS site, the inner TLS runs between your device and that site. The node only forwards it and can't see the content.
strings.内部测试应用，不开放公众使用。: Internal test app, not open to the public.
strings.只有持有正确公钥与短 ID 的客户端才能接入。其它任何连接都会被原样转交给真实的: Only clients holding the right public key and short ID can connect. Any other connection is handed to a real overseas website unchanged, so the server itself stays "invisible".
strings.基于 {0} 的 ECDHE 协商，每条连接都生成全新的会话密钥，具备前向保密：: ECDHE key exchange on {0} gives every connection a fresh session key with forward secrecy: even if a key leaks later, past traffic can't be decrypted.
strings.多层加密隧道 + 自研「幻影」指纹抹除引擎。在网络中，你的连接看起来与访问普通网: A multi-layer encrypted tunnel plus our own "Phantom" fingerprint-removal engine. On the network your connection looks just like visiting an ordinary website, with no identifiable proxy traits.
strings.安装前请保持邀请码已复制，首次打开会自动识别。: Keep the invite code copied before installing; it is picked up on first launch.
strings.安装包校验失败，请重试: Package verification failed. Please try again.
strings.安装后首次打开自动领取 {0} 天会员: Get {0} days of membership automatically on first launch
strings.客户端发出的 ClientHello 与 Chrome 浏览器逐字段一致，在指纹: The client's ClientHello matches Chrome field by field, so fingerprint databases classify it as an "ordinary browser".
strings.客户端每 60 秒探测各条通道，故障自动切换；大陆网站直连不绕路，境外流量走加密: The client probes every channel every 60 seconds and fails over automatically. Mainland sites go direct, overseas traffic goes through the encrypted tunnel.
strings.所有可用节点组成负载均衡池，自动选最快的一条；任一节点异常，无感切换。: All available nodes form a load-balanced pool and the fastest is picked automatically. If a node fails, it switches seamlessly.
strings.握手时呈现真实知名网站的 SNI 与完整证书链，无自签证书、无需自有域名，不留可: The handshake presents the SNI and full certificate chain of a real, well-known website: no self-signed certificate, no own domain needed, and no traceable certificate fingerprint.
strings.支持 Windows 10 / 11（64 位）。下载后解压，打开文件夹里的 H: Supports Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit). Unzip the download and open Huanyou.exe in the folder; don't copy the exe out on its own. Once connected it works through the system proxy, so browsers and most programs need no setup.
strings.支持 macOS 12 及以上（Apple 芯片和 Intel）。下载后双击打开: Supports macOS 12 and later (Apple silicon and Intel). Double-click the download and drag 环游 into Applications. If the first launch says the developer can't be verified, right-click the app and choose Open. Needs an administrator account; once connected it works through the system proxy.
strings.数据以 {0} / {1} AEAD 算法加密，同时校验完整性，任何篡改都会被立: Data is encrypted with {0} / {1} AEAD, which also checks integrity: any tampering is detected and dropped at once.
strings.本页面及安装包仅供受邀的内部测试人员使用，请勿转发或公开传播。: This page and the packages are for invited internal testers only. Please don't forward or share them publicly.
strings.正在安装，App 将自动重新打开…: Installing, the app will reopen automatically…
strings.每次连接独立密钥: A new key for every connection
strings.没有写入安装目录的权限，请用浏览器下载新版本手动安装: No permission to write the install folder. Please download the new version in the browser and install it manually.
strings.端到端，节点不解密: End to end, never decrypted at the node
strings.节点不做二次 TLS、不改写目标、不添加代理头。目标网站看到的是一次普通直连，而: The node adds no second TLS layer, doesn't rewrite the destination and adds no proxy headers. The website sees an ordinary direct connection, not one "through a proxy".
strings.识别代理靠的从来不是“内容”，而是“特征”：握手指纹、证书、包长与时序、探测反应: Proxies are never identified by their content but by their traits: handshake fingerprint, certificate, packet sizes and timing, and how they react to probes. {0}'s own fingerprint-removal engine removes these one by one, so the connection looks like ordinary browsing again.
strings.请先把「环游」拖到「应用程序」文件夹，从那里打开后再更新: Drag 环游 into the Applications folder and open it from there before updating
strings.请用 Safari 打开本页安装；仅已登记设备的测试人员可以安装。安装后如提示「: Open this page in Safari to install; only testers with registered devices can install. If it says "Untrusted Developer", trust it in Settings → General → VPN & Device Management.
strings.连接单个节点，国内直连、境外加密，延迟最低，日常浏览与视频首选。: Connects to a single node: mainland sites direct, overseas traffic encrypted. Lowest latency, best for everyday browsing and video.
strings.零附加头，原样转发: No added headers, forwarded as is
strings.面对主动探测，服务器把连接交给真实网站，探测方拿到的是真证书、真页面，无从判断。: Against active probing, the server hands the connection to a real website: the prober gets a real certificate and a real page, and can't tell.
strings.这不是官方发布的{0}，为了你的账号和数据安全已停止运行。请卸载后从官网下载正版: This is not an official release of {0}, so it stopped to keep your account and data safe. Please uninstall it and download the official app from our website.
